item: Seeder report adds up, and a refused conflicting lean is listed once
summary: Every catalogue entry now lands in exactly one seed counter (created + skipped == total): a feed-less entry merged onto a feed row the database already held counts as merged, and an entry with no name counts as malformed beside one with no domain. A feed-less entry's lean tag refused because the row holds a different lean is recorded once in the row's baseline (refused_tags: the kept tag, the entry, its catalogue), listed with its reason on the boot that refuses it and only counted as refused_standing afterwards, so the report stays visible and the log stays quiet; the refusal lapses when the kept lean is removed.
